what: Build of the four images that the verification of 2026-10-25 listed as not built (molecular properties, ADMET-AI, protonation, thermostability) from the commit below, with each image's environment check and the repository tests of its engine run against it on the CPU. Release 1.0.0 of the source.

host.name: Spark
host.note: the GPU was not used; the tests ran on the CPU

build.note: every layer, including the core and the engine stages, was built from the commit and the recipes; nothing was taken from an earlier cache, and each Dockerfile.tests layer adds pytest to the engine image.

images.extras: quantitative dossier trajectory chemistry routes thermodynamics construct coding-design embedding-analysis

images.note: the image is large because torch 2.15.0 comes from the PyPI Linux wheel, which installs the NVIDIA CUDA packages (32 nvidia package directories in the environment, 6.3 GB in all); the ThermoMPNN and TemBERTure images use the PyTorch CPU wheel index instead
the 5 skipped tests need the OpenFE or the OpenMM environment, which this image does not set

images.tests: test_protein_predict_melting_temperature with the temberture-tm resource mounted read-only: 21 passed (76 s)

not_verified: the images of the verification of 2026-10-25 were not rebuilt
